title: PreferenceLocalization
description: Optional localization catalog for resolving `%key%` references and tree labels. See docs/specification.md (Localization Contract). The presence of `messages[defaultLocale]` is required by the contract but enforced at runtime.

defaultLocale.description: Fallback locale code. Must be present as a key in `messages`.

messages.description: Locale code to message-key map. Each value resolves to Markdown text.
